summary: Python SDK: streaming chat disconnects cause opaque exception (no retry metadata)
description: Customer on Dedicated reports intermittent network disconnects during streaming chat. The Python SDK raises a generic ConnectionError without including request_id, last_event_id, or guidance for resuming. They want the exception to include response headers and partial transcript to support app-level retries.
comments: Support (Sofia): Confirmed disconnects align with a corporate proxy idle timeout; not necessarily Redwood backend.

Eng (Elliot): Improving error surface in streaming iterator: include request_id, status code (if available), and last received chunk index. Also document recommended retry strategy (restart request, include conversation history).
Support (Sofia): Customer validated new error fields in 1.8.5 and can implement safe retries. Marking resolved.
